slots.name: status of invoking Insurrection Act
slots.sentence: Trump isn't ruling out invoking the Insurrection Act around the midterm election as the contest enters the final weeks with Republicans trailing in key races, as the president continues to stoke unfounded concerns about widespread voter fraud.
